title: risimu ra tintshava loko ri pela
intro: Yingisela loko minkova yi twala hi ku dzunisa etlhelo ka nandza la hlawuriweke wa Allah. Rito leri nga ni nyiko ya vuyimbeleri, ku avanyisa loku laviwaka hi lava kanetaka ekamareni ni nsimbi leyi olovisiweke hi xileriso xa Xikwembu swi rindzele ku tshuburiwa. Hi xihi xifaniso xa vugandzeri ni ku fuma loku lulameke lexi vulavulaka hi swikombiso leswi?
clues: Ndzi katekisiwile hi Allah hi ku hanana ni rito ro dzunisa leri twalaka.
Ndzi dyondzisiwe hi Allah ku twisisa ririmi ra ku avanyisa loku lulameke exikarhi ka lava kanetanaka.
Ndzi langutane ni nhenha leyikulu ya matimba enyimpini naswona hi ku navela ka Allah ndzi va hlule.
Ndzi nyikiwile vutlhari, vulawuri na tsalwa leri paluxiweke ra tipisalema ku suka eka Allah.
Ndzi joyiniwe hi tintshava ni swinyenyana eku dzuniseni ka Allah na mina nimadyambu ni loko dyambu ri huma.
Ndzi dyondzisiwe hi Allah ku endla majazi ya poso hi nsimbi leyi endliweke yi olova eka mina.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: U hlule Jalut (Goliath) enyimpini hi ku navela ka Allah
U ake Areka leswaku a pona ndhambi leyikulu
U lahleriwe endzilweni lowu Allah wu wu endleke wu kufumela
U mitiwe hi nhlampfi leyikulu elwandle
U pfuxeriwe ematilweni handle ko nantswa rifu
trial.answer: U hlule Jalut (Goliath) enyimpini hi ku navela ka Allah

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka
options: Tintshava ni swinyenyana leswi hlanganeke eku dzuniseni ka Allah
Nhonga leyi hundzukeke nyoka
Ndzilo lowu veke ni ku kufumela ni ku rhula
Kamela ya xisati leyi rhumeriweke tanihi xikombiso eka vanhu
Areka ya mapulanga leyi tshameke eNtshaveni ya Yudi
location.answer: Tintshava ni swinyenyana leswi hlanganeke eku dzuniseni ka Allah

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Ku nyikiwa vuhosi, vutlhari ni Zabur (Tipisalema) .
U nyikiwile n’wana wa mufana loko a dyuharile endzhaku ka xikhongelo lexi tiyeke
Yi nyikiwile vuhlayiseki ebakweni ku ringana malembe yo tala
Ku nyikiwile xihlovo xa Zamzam emananga
Ku pfumeleriwa ku nwela ka vuthu elwandle
outcome.answer: Ku nyikiwa vuhosi, vutlhari ni Zabur (Tipisalema) .

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
